title: Make Home your own
summary: Shape the home screen around how you actually watch.
includes: Hide the sections you don’t use, from the side menu, Home and Search
Open straight to your favorite page at startup (out in 2.4.3)
Set a display name for a personal greeting
A birthday surprise, Surprise me for your own files, and a look at what you’ve watched
Take things off Continue watching
reply: Built and being tested on Wii U now. The start screen came out in 2.4.3; the rest is planned for an upcoming update.

title: Display options
summary: A quieter interface, and video that fits the TV you have.
includes: Turn animated background effects off
Choose fit, stretch or letterbox in the player
4:3 output considered for CRTs and older TVs
reply: A Reduce motion switch that turns animations off is built for an upcoming update. Fit, stretch and letterbox are still to do.

title: Type without the GamePad
summary: Use the on-screen keyboard with a Wii Remote or a Pro Controller, even when the GamePad isn’t within reach.

title: Autoplay the next episode
summary: Keep a series rolling: continue to the next Jellyfin episode automatically, with an option to turn it off.

title: More servers and libraries
summary: Reach your media and books on more of the servers you already run at home.
includes: Browse and play files over FTP, including a phone acting as your media server
Calibre-Web and Kavita libraries, read in CoffeeFlix next to the local EPUB and CBZ reader
reply: I'm checking what the Wii U can handle before promising anything here.

title: YouTube account extras
summary: More from your signed-in YouTube account. Profile access and account compatibility need investigating.
includes: Like and dislike videos while signed in
YouTube Kids profile support
reply: Like and dislike (with the counts) and Kids profiles with their own YouTube are built and being tested for an upcoming update.

title: Community add-ons for YouTube
summary: Bring two popular community projects to CoffeeFlix.
includes: Return YouTube Dislike counts
Calmer titles and thumbnails in the spirit of DeArrow, with an option to see the originals
reply: Dislike counts from Return YouTube Dislike are built. For titles and thumbnails I made CoffeeFlix’s own DeArrow-style options (calmer titles, a frame from the video) instead of using the DeArrow service. Both are in testing for an upcoming update.

title: Twitch account and channel points
summary: Sign in to Twitch for account features. Feasibility and service support need checking.
includes: Your followed channels
Collect channel points while you watch
reply: Signing in depends on what Twitch allows on a console, so I'm checking that first.

title: Watch more on Twitch
summary: More ways to enjoy a stream, beyond the live video.
includes: Past broadcasts (VODs) next to live streams
Chat with 7TV and BTTV emotes
Polls and predictions where possible

title: Navidrome and Subsonic music servers
summary: Play your own music library from a Navidrome or other Subsonic-compatible server.
reply: A community pull request (#27) added this. It’s merged into my development version and being tested on Wii U for an upcoming update.

title: DVD playback
summary: Watch DVDs on the Wii U through a USB DVD drive, at the best quality the console can show. Whether the Wii U lets apps read a USB drive still has to be found out.
includes: Play all kinds of DVDs from a USB DVD drive
Show the picture at the best quality possible, upscaled to the TV’s resolution
DVD menus
Music CDs and disc images (ISO) considered too
reply: I’m checking whether the Wii U lets apps read a USB DVD drive, and aiming to play every kind of DVD at the best quality it can show.

title: Remember my subtitles
summary: Turn subtitles on once and they stay on the next time you open that show or video.
includes: Keep the subtitle language you chose for each show
Keep subtitles off when you turned them off

title: M3U playlists
summary: Open M3U playlists from the SD card or a USB drive and play your videos and music straight from them, like WiiMC.

title: Better photo viewing
summary: Photos from today’s phones and cameras that open quickly and look right.
includes: Fast thumbnails, even for large camera photos
Turn a photo, and phone photos stand upright on their own
Details: date taken, camera, size
A slideshow like the Wii Photo Channel, with music, that zooms in on one person and stays wide for a group
reply: Built and tried on Wii U. Large photos load much faster now. It’s planned for an upcoming update.
